claims.statement: The accessible name is computed by traversing aria-labelledby, aria-label, native host language labeling elements, and descendant text content in priority order.

proof.quote: The accessible name is computed by traversing aria-labelledby, aria-label, native host language labeling elements, and descendant text content in priority order.

claims.statement: Elements with aria-hidden='true' or CSS display: none are not exposed in the accessibility tree.

proof.quote: Elements with aria-hidden='true' or CSS display: none are not exposed in the accessibility tree.
